notes: K1: perimeter along Mazowiecka (4 'plots', cornice +21.00 = attic of No. 19, set-back storey to +23.6), tower in zone A to +38.2 m with rounded NE corner R 13 m; Sejmik storey 10 m high + mezzanine 416 m² (public gallery, clubs); 'Hall of the Voivodeship' crossing from the bridge square to the garden court; 13,906 m² GFA; 147.0 M PLN.

K2: two-storey brick citizens' arcade (54.6 m) along the bridgehead, 'campanile' 9.45 × 9.45 × 44 m hinging the two street grids, tower attic +37.0, wings +20.3; 14,161 m² GFA; 148.6 M PLN (0.9 % headroom — tight).

Critical legal finding (verified against ISAP): the 2002 technical regulation (WT) expired on 20 Sep 2026 and no new one has been published; designs may follow the old WT for 18 months under art. 102a of the Building Law — our entry states this explicitly and checks against the 2026 draft.
Also new: civil-protection act (from 29 May 2026) requires shelter capacity → the garage doubles as an emergency shelter; above 25 m non-combustible façades, no balconies.
Next: K3 (civic forum), K4 (zero-emission hybrid), K5 (dynamic modernism) → 5 jurors in parallel → synthesis.
